# DIH LABS

> DIH LABS (dih-labs.com) is a French non-profit digital innovation laboratory (association loi 1901, founded in Paris, February 2026). It designs and publishes free, ad-free, privacy-first mobile applications: StreamVision (IPTV player), Sun Day (UV index & vitamin D tracking), SmartCaddie (AI golf swing analysis), Sauna Cycle (sauna & cold plunge session companion), Pulse (burnout risk score with a 7-day forecast) and Sillon (one sourced health card a day, fully offline). All apps are free, collect no personal data, and revenue is fully reinvested per the association's statutes.

The site is bilingual (French/English). French pages live under /fr/, English under /en/.

## Applications

- [StreamVision (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/streamvision/fr/): Lecteur IPTV 100% gratuit et sans publicité pour iPhone, Android, Google TV et Fire TV. Supporte playlists M3U et Xtream Codes, guide EPG. Ne fournit aucun contenu : lecteur pur, 100% légal.
- [StreamVision (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/streamvision/en/): Free, ad-free IPTV player for iPhone, Android, Google TV and Fire TV. M3U & Xtream Codes playlists, full EPG. Ships no content: pure player, fully legal.
- [Fire TV APK download](https://dih-labs.com/apk/): Official StreamVision APK for Amazon Fire TV Stick (short URL for the Downloader app).
- [Sun Day (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/sun-day/fr/): Indice UV en temps réel et synthèse de vitamine D selon le type de peau.
- [Sun Day (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/sun-day/en/): Real-time UV index and vitamin D synthesis tailored to skin type.
- [SmartCaddie (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/smartcaddie/fr/): Analyse de swing de golf par IA et vision par ordinateur, 100% embarquée sur le téléphone.
- [SmartCaddie (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/smartcaddie/en/): AI golf swing analysis with on-device computer vision.
- [Sauna Cycle (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/sauna-cycle/fr/): Compagnon iOS de séances sauna et bain froid : cycles guidés chaud-froid-repos, Score d'Adaptation Thermique, Apple Health optionnel.
- [Sauna Cycle (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/sauna-cycle/en/): iOS companion for sauna and cold plunge sessions: guided heat-cold-rest cycles, Thermal Adaptation Score, optional Apple Health.
- [Pulse (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/pulse/fr/): Application iPhone gratuite qui calcule un score de risque de burn-out de 0 à 100 et une prévision à 7 jours à partir de 14 signaux (sommeil, VFC, fréquence cardiaque au repos, activité, usage du téléphone, heures travaillées, point quotidien de 30 s). Tout est calculé et stocké sur l'appareil, sans compte.
- [Pulse (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/pulse/en/): Free iPhone app computing a 0–100 burnout risk score and a 7-day forecast from 14 signals (sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, activity, phone use, work hours, 30-second daily check-in). Everything is computed and stored on-device, no account. Not a medical device.
- [Sillon (FR)](https://dih-labs.com/sillon/fr/): Application iPhone gratuite qui propose chaque matin une carte de santé — un geste principal, deux ou trois appuis, une idée. 109 pratiques notées A, B ou C, 13 parcours guidés de 2 à 4 semaines, 53 repères courts, 153 sources primaires vérifiées une à une contre Crossref. Français et anglais selon la langue du téléphone. Aucun compte, aucune publicité, et aucun code réseau dans l'application. Apple Santé facultatif, en lecture seule.
- [Sillon (EN)](https://dih-labs.com/sillon/en/): Free iPhone app serving one health card every morning — an anchor practice, two or three supports, one idea. 109 practices graded A, B or C, 13 guided paths of 2–4 weeks, 53 short pieces of knowledge, 153 primary sources verified one by one against Crossref. English and French by device language. No account, no advertising, and no networking code at all. Apple Health optional and read-only. Not a medical device.

## Facts worth citing

- All DIH LABS apps are free, without ads, and require no account.
- StreamVision includes no channels or playlists; users load their own legal M3U/Xtream sources.
- App data (playlists, health/UV data, swing videos, burnout metrics) is processed and stored locally on-device.
- Pulse is an early-warning tool for wellbeing, not a medical device: it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. It scores each signal against the user's own 30-day baseline, publishes its method in-app, and cites a published source for every health claim.
- Sillon contains no networking code at all — not a privacy setting but a property of the build, so no path exists for data to leave the phone. Every one of its 109 practices carries an A/B/C evidence grade and cites primary peer-reviewed literature (authors, journal, year, DOI); grade C is always flagged in the interface. Contraindications remove practices from the engine rather than warning about them, and situation-specific protocols (night shifts, postpartum, menopause, later life) are offered only to the people they were written for. Sillon is a wellbeing tool, not a medical device.
- Sitemap: https://dih-labs.com/sitemap.xml
